fields.id: Stable case id; also the case page slug
fields.url: Case page on shrinkradar.com (quotes the source)
fields.country: ISO-style country code (UK for the United Kingdom, EU for EU-wide)
fields.when: When the change happened or was reported, as given by the source
fields.year: Four-digit year parsed from 'when' (n/d if none)
fields.unit: Unit of both sizes (g, ml, oz, sheets, pieces…)
fields.unit_price_rise_same_price_pct: Hidden unit-price rise if the shelf price stayed the same = (before ÷ after − 1) × 100
fields.old_price: Shelf price before, as recorded by the source (with currency symbol), if any
fields.new_price: Shelf price after, as recorded by the source, if any
fields.currency: Currency symbol of the two prices (€, £, $), if both parse
fields.real_unit_price_change_pct: Change in price per unit combining size and shelf price, if both prices are known and in the same currency
fields.retailer: Store where the source bought or saw the pack, if recorded
fields.date_reported: Date the source published or logged the case, as written by the source
fields.source: Name of the source we fetched
fields.also_reported: Other sources reporting the same change (space-separated URLs)
fields.archive_url: Archived copy of the source, if any
fields.evidence_type: Kind of evidence behind the source
